content.comment_body: I have a [article_no] PLC that is not working. Can I use a microSD card to copy and transfer the program to a new unit? Also, what size and type of memory should I use?
The microSD card should have a maximum capacity of 32 GB and be formatted with FAT32.

analysis.insight_summary: User experienced a malfunction with a specific PLC device and asked about using a microSD card to transfer the program to a replacement unit. The user sought details regarding the appropriate type and size of memory card. The replies provided memory specifications but did not offer a complete process or compatibility information for program transfer between units.
analysis.user_expectations: User seeks a straightforward and dependable method to transfer a PLC program using readily available hardware such as a microSD card, along with clear instructions on suitable memory card specifications.
